success.description: You mark the site and protect it with the vigil of nature. No matter where you are or what your current state is, you will instantly be aware the next time a tainted or unnatural presence enters the area. Tainted or unnatural creatures include mutants (including beastmen), daemons, the undead, or those bearing a Mark of Chaos. As soon as a tainted creature enters the protected site, the vigil ends. You can only stand vigil over as many sites as your character rank.

boon.description: You gain some approximate knowledge of the types and numbers of creatures that enter the site.

bane.description: You suffer 2 stress when your alarm triggers.

conservative.requirements: Requires a character rank of 4. Can only invoke in a tamed natural environment such as an orchard, farm, or park. You must personally mark the site, such as with your own blood or a unique sigil crafted by you.
